component.name: Yacr
component.summary: Cross-platform open-source CAD for DWG/DXF drawings
面向 DWG/DXF 图纸的跨平台开源 CAD

description.p: Yacr is a cross-platform open-source CAD project. A shared Rust core handles DWG/DXF documents, geometry and rendering; React + Tauri provides the desktop UI. It opens local DWG/DXF drawings and shows model space and supported layouts. Linux/Wayland is the primary development target with the strongest support; the Android APK has been sideloaded by the maintainer, and the Windows/macOS hosts are real but their runtime acceptance is still pending.
Yacr 是一个跨平台开源 CAD 项目：共享的 Rust 核心负责 DWG/DXF 文档、几何与渲染， React + Tauri 提供桌面界面。它可打开本地 DWG/DXF 图纸，查看模型空间与受支持的布局。 Linux/Wayland 是主开发目标，支持最完整；Android APK 已由维护者侧载运行；Windows/macOS 是真实宿主，运行时验收仍待补。
